method: Annual CPS Food Security Supplement household survey; USDA ERS publishes prevalence and statistical significance notes.
uncertainty: Food insecurity is a resource-constrained food-access outcome, not a general financial-wellbeing or consumption measure. Annual estimates have sampling error and should be interpreted with the USDA significance guidance.
counterinterpretation: The 2024 food-insecurity prevalence was not statistically significantly different from 2023; a small numerical increase is not necessarily a population-level change.
